scope: Independent offline visual review of finalized native04, focusing on CanopySurfaceV2 and ShadeBalanceV1. Ground, architecture and metal are unchanged context. The old native generator is excluded from new-source approval. No app input or scene mutation by this critic.
acceptanceRule: Every applicable hero and close category must reach at least 4, with no focal hard defect. The partial gains below do not establish overall AAA quality. Null means unqualified, not a pass.

improvements: V3 drape, folded seams, patch contours and continuous hem remain intact. No renewed black slit or open-hole defect is visible in reviewed native04 views.
SurfaceV2 is quieter and less saturated than native03, with the rejected source-v1 cloudy bleaching and uniform pale hem avoided.
Patch and seam detail remain coherent in the short consecutive-frame samples.
remainingDefects: Broad fold highlights still read like a smooth coated sheet; the top at hour18.25 is especially glossy across fold ridges. This remains below the weathered cloth reference.

The noon underside is a broad smooth dark red field with weak cloth identity. At16 and17.5 the entrance lamp produces stable angular bright bands, which become more explicit as ambient light falls at18.25 and0.
Localized aging is still too quiet at the whole-canopy and frontage views. The reference shows clearer abrasion, faded handling areas and fabric history around seams and repairs.
canopy.physicalDetailCaveat: The retained cotton uses a physical0.3m source tile. Submillimetre yarn can be subpixel when a roughly5m canopy fills1920px, so lack of visible individual yarn in a wide view is not proof of missing maps. Do not enlarge the weave solely to make grain visible.
boundedNextChecks: Isolate the local lamp, its shadows, cloth normals and canopy self-shadow in matched native views before prescribing a material or lighting fix. The saved Finery lamp is a point light; the angular bands are not evidence of a spotlight cone.
Add a player-height near view of the hem, patch and seam with enough pixel coverage to evaluate stitches, localized abrasion and normal response at physical scale.
Check actual native roughness/specular and composed normal behavior against source appearance. Preserve V3 geometry and the restrained V2 color history while correcting any demonstrated shader issue.

Only after those checks, audition modest thin-cloth daylight transmission if needed for material identity. Patches and doubled hems should attenuate it; avoid emission or night glow. This is an experiment, not a proven remedy for the angular bands.

findings: The16 and17.5 views open shaded stone, paving and props while retaining recess depth, warm sun rims and practical-light contrast. The reviewed views do not show broad color washing.

The18.25 and0 views preserve the transition to a dark night scene. Noon remains strongly sunlit. There is no observed global noon/night regression in this set; exact03 versus04 comparisons at17.5,18.25 and0 were not available.
Additional global ambient or sky fill is not justified by the remaining cloth problem. Its broad surface response and local lamp bands need a bounded diagnosis.

actualNativeState.interpretation: ShadeBalance changes the17.5 ambient/fill key and therefore its interpolated neighboring hours. Sun, exposure and lamps retain the original curve. Hour16 has about half the noon sun intensity and lower global fill, with a much stronger practical lamp; these are different lighting conditions, not a texture-only comparison. Parameter ratios are not direct pixel-luminance ratios.

shadeBalance.reflectionEvidence: The separate shade report records five settled transitions with two expected new captures each, zero failures and actual probe textures present. Identity remained unchanged. Reflection bookkeeping is not art acceptance.

shadeStills.method: Each image decoded and visually inspected at native1920x1080. All35 were reviewed.

motion.method: Offline original-resolution FFmpeg extraction, then actual inspection of every successive still. Each burst spans only0.167seconds. This is sampled sequential imagery, not uninterrupted movie playback.
motion.finding: No obvious local UV jump, LOD pop, new hole, contact jump, clipping or ghost trail in these short bursts. Lamp bands persist stably. Fine line antialiasing, long-range transitions, foliage shimmer and general animation remain unqualified by this limited sample.
motion.walkFinding: Sampled approach and departure views show unobstructed porch access and no obvious camera-through-wall frame. Close shutter and Finery door frames confirm unchanged metal-art weaknesses. Sparse walk samples do not establish full temporal stability.
